definitions.explanation: The temporary closure of a room or facility such as a classroom, studio, gym, or consultation room. Used on signs and notices to indicate that a space is not available on certain days.

examples.japanese: {本日|ほんじつ}{休室|きゅうしつ}。
⟦{毎週|まいしゅう}→毎週：00730_maishuu⟧⟦{月曜日|げつようび}→月曜日：00624_getsuyoubi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{休室|きゅうしつ}です。

⟦{空調|くうちょう}→空調：27362_kuuchou⟧⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{会議室|かいぎしつ}→会議室：01265_kaigishitsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{休室|きゅうしつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なります→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ご⟦{利用|りよう}→利用：01752_riyou⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Due to air conditioning work, the meeting room will be closed next week, so please use a different room.

notes:
Composed of {休|きゅう} (rest, closure) and ⟦{室|しつ}→室：09946_shitsu⟧ (room). Follows the same pattern as ⟦{休館|きゅうかん}→休館：18859_kyuukan⟧ (library/museum closure), ⟦{休業|きゅうぎょう}→休業：11541_kyuugyou⟧ (business closure), and {休店|きゅうてん} (shop closure). Seen on signs at studios, classrooms, gyms, consultation rooms, and other facilities.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {本日|ほんじつ}{休室|きゅうしつ}: closed today
- ⟦{臨時|りんじ}→臨時：04092_rinji⟧{休室|きゅうしつ}: temporarily closed
- {休室|きゅうしつ}{日|び}: closure day
- {休室|きゅうしつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦お{知|し}らせ→お知らせ：18843_oshirase⟧: closure notice

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{休館|きゅうかん}→休館：18859_kyuukan⟧: closure (of a library, museum, or public building) — same pattern
- ⟦{休業|きゅうぎょう}→休業：11541_kyuugyou⟧: business closure; closed for the day — for shops and businesses
- ⟦{休講|きゅうこう}→休講：19951_kyuukou⟧: class cancellation — specifically for university lectures
- {休園|きゅうえん}: closure (of a park or kindergarten)
